# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release/preview version of Devfolio Android receives security updates and bug fixes.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x (alpha) | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1.0 | :x:                |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of our users and credentials seriously. Since this application handles Devfolio session cookies and access tokens locally on the device, safeguarding user privacy and data integrity is paramount.

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Devfolio Android, please follow these guidelines:

### How to Report
- **Do not open a public GitHub issue** for sensitive security vulnerabilities or credential leakage risks.
- Please use [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/insaneodyssey26/devfolio-app/security/advisories/new) on this repository to submit details privately.
- Alternatively, you can reach out directly to the maintainer via email or direct message.

### What to Include in Your Report
To help us triage and resolve the issue quickly, please provide:
1. A clear description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
2. Step-by-step instructions or proof-of-concept (PoC) code to reproduce the issue.
3. Affected device or Android versions.
4. Any suggested fixes or remediation steps if you have them.

---

## Devfolio Platform Vulnerabilities

Please note that this repository is an **unofficial, community-built mobile client**. 

If you discover a security issue or vulnerability directly within Devfolio's official backend APIs, web infrastructure, or servers (`devfolio.co`, `api.devfolio.co`), please report it directly to Devfolio's official security contact at **security@devfolio.co** or through their official disclosure channels.
